candidates.title: Who will perform at the 2027 Pro Football Championship Halftime Show scheduled for Sunday, February 14, 2027?
candidates.rules_primary: If Guns N' Roses performs at (or it is announced that they will perform at) the 2027 Pro Football Championship Halftime Show scheduled for Sunday, February 14, 2027 during the official event timeframe, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
Additional clarification(s):

Guns N' Roses appears on stage or in the official broadcast or stream; AND

Guns N' Roses actively and perceptibly contributes to a musical performance by singing (including audible lead or backing vocals), rapping, playing a musical instrument, DJ-ing, or conducting a live band; AND

Is either a scheduled performer, a guest appearance during another artist's set, or is formally announced as a performer by official event organizers or Guns N' Roses's official representatives.

Note: This Contract may resolve on the announcement of Guns N' Roses’s anticipated performance at the 2027 Pro Football Championship Halftime Show scheduled for Sunday, February 14, 2027. If an announced Guns N' Roses later withdraws from the 2027 Pro Football Championship Halftime Show scheduled for Sunday, February 14, 2027, this will not affect the resolution of the Contract.

The following constitutes a performance and IS encompassed by the Payout Criterion:

A full solo performance of one or more songs.

A collaborative or joint performance in which Guns N' Roses is physically present and actively contributes musically.

A guest appearance during another artist's set in which Guns N' Roses performs at least one full verse, chorus, or musical segment.

A medley in which Guns N' Roses is present and actively performing, even if Guns N' Roses's portion is partial.

A performance in which Guns N' Roses performs entirely via an officially produced and sanctioned satellite feed, video link, or holographic display that is presented as part of the official live event program, provided that the performance is real-time or was produced specifically for and presented exclusively within the 2027 Pro Football Championship Halftime Show scheduled for Sunday, February 14, 2027.

A DJ set in which Guns N' Roses is the performing DJ operating equipment live, regardless of whether Guns N' Roses sings.

A pre-recorded performance segment presented as part of the official event program, provided it is attributed to Guns N' Roses by the official event organizers and presented as a performance (rather than a tribute, retrospective, or archival clip).

A performance that begins within the official event timeframe but extends beyond it due to scheduling overrun, provided the performance commenced during the official timeframe.

A performance at a rescheduled version of the 2027 Pro Football Championship Halftime Show scheduled for Sunday, February 14, 2027 where the reschedule occurs within one year of the original event date, pursuant to the postponement provisions below.

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the Governing League. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.
